title: OpenCTI Hunt
description: The hunt SDO of the extension definition extension-definition--1c445ca2-6982-5163-9107-7e89bc1693d1: a threat hunt, its falsifiable hypothesis, its canonical Sigma rule with per-platform native queries, the threats and techniques it targets and its execution guardrails. Common STIX 2.1 SDO properties (labels, confidence, external_references, object_marking_refs, created_by_ref...) apply as well.

hypothesis.description: The falsifiable hypothesis the hunt tests.

hunt_type.description: telemetry: a detection rule searched in the telemetry of a security platform; indicators: indicator and observable values looked up; infrastructure: internet-facing infrastructure searched.

hunt_source_kind.description: Who wrote the hunt: an analyst, an agent or the XTM Hub.

sigma_rule.description: The canonical logic of the hunt, as a Sigma rule in YAML.

native_queries.description: The logic of the hunt translated for each platform it runs on.

pipeline.description: The Sigma processing pipeline the query was translated with.

hunt_ioc_filters.description: Filter group, as JSON, selecting the indicators and observables an indicator hunt looks for.

hunt_ioc_values.description: Values pasted into an indicator hunt.

hunt_scope.description: Filter group, as JSON, over the security platforms the hunt runs on; empty in a hunt pack.

hunt_schedule.description: manual, standing, or the interval of a scheduled hunt.

trigger_filters.description: Filter group, as JSON, of the knowledge events that trigger a standing hunt; empty in a hunt pack.

time_window_hours.description: Time window a run searches, in hours.

escalation_threshold.description: New hits from which an autonomous run opens an incident.

technique_refs.description: The attack patterns the hunt covers.

source_refs.description: The intelligence the hunt is based on.
